Hi Sam — thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary and proposed next steps below. I’m copying Ben who runs the evidence handoff workflows.

Short answers up front:
- Claim retirement: Redwood will create a retirement record in Whistic, capture a CAIQ/SIG snapshot (signed hash), and move the proof to an escrow bucket with a signed manifest. We retain the manifest and audit log for 365 days by default; the escrow object TTL is configurable per-account.
- Escrow mechanism: presigned S3 objects + a signed manifest stored in our attestations store (immutable). Recommended short TTL for presigned upload keys: 24 hours for uploads; escrow object retention 90 days (adjustable).

Attached is a concise checklist for BridgePay (two pages) and a small presign-policy snippet Ben suggested. Proposed immediate actions:
1) Confirm desired escrow retention (90 / 180 / 365 days).
2) We’ll create a BridgePay-specific Whistic claim tag and one-time presign bucket; you’ll receive the presign window link.
3) Sign the small addendum (DocuSign) for preservation mechanics if you want escrow beyond standard 90 days.

If that timeline works I’ll route the addendum to Alicia and spin up the presign workflow.

Onwards,
Olga Petrov

Olga / team — adding a few implementation specifics so BridgePay has something prescriptive to hand to their GRC:

Technical notes (summary):
- Presign windows: Generate a pre-signed PUT with a 24h expiry. For uploads that must span longer business days, we can provide a short-lived STS token (max 12 hours) scoped to a single object upload.
- Escrow bucket policy: Objects uploaded to escrow are tagged with account-id and claim-id; lifecycle rule moves to Glacier-type storage after the configured escrow retention. The signed manifest (sha256 over object list + timestamps) is stored in our attestations service (append-only).
- Audit trail: For each retirement we produce: Whistic claim retirement event (timestamp + actor), presign issuance event, upload receipt, manifest hash, and S3 object metadata (etag + size). We can export an artifacts bundle as a zip for audits.

Operational steps (for BridgePay):
1) Choose retention: 90 days (default) / 180 / 365.
2) Confirm whether BridgePay legal needs escrow as part of the MSA (if yes we’ll prepare a one-paragraph addendum).
3) Provide a list of the claim IDs you expect to retire in the first wave (small sample ok).

I attached the presign-policy-snippet.txt and a sample manifest template. I’ll build the presign link once Olga confirms retention.

Thanks — Ben
